protocol.scope: Actual Native remux player, authored36s H264/AAC TS,50ms server response delay for each media request only; no bandwidth cap. Network emulator is not actual WAN. Byte counters are server ReadStream bytes, including possible buffered/abandoned bytes; not exact client reception.
protocol.workload: player open through0.5s advancement,3s active,seek15 and5 and28 each API-complete+0.2s observed progression,1xEOF,destroy
protocol.primary: startup plus three seek completion latencies
protocol.gate: median>=10% reduction, allfive pairs lower, everycandidate server-read media-byte increase<=30%
protocol.limits: Browser launch/common harness load excluded; all media responses delayed, module/runtime responses not delayed. Startup charges player creation. ChromeCPU excludes server/OS media services. Localhost cold browser contexts do not flush OS cache. Not physical first sound/photon.
